effects.does: Copies the displayed project information to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Copy and verify that the expected project information is available in the clipboard.

effects.does: Copies the associated value represented by the copy icon to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click the copy icon and verify that its adjacent value can be pasted elsewhere.

effects.does: Opens the Clara assistant for the project.
effects.affects: Nothing changes unless Clara performs an action on the event.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara interface opens.

effects.does: Starts creating a new version of the project.
effects.affects: Creates a new editable project version using the existing project context.
effects.check: Click Create New Version and verify that the project creation screen opens with the existing project data.

effects.does: Opens the project's communication messages.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Messages and verify that the project's conversation view opens.

effects.does: Opens the project settings view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Settings and verify that the settings view is displayed.

effects.does: Opens the project actions menu.
effects.affects: Nothing until an action is selected.
effects.check: Click Actions and verify that the available project actions are listed.

effects.does: Opens the response progress represented by the 0 / 1 and 0% indicator.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click the progress indicator and verify that the corresponding response details are shown.

effects.does: Opens the response template.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Click here and verify that the response template opens.

effects.does: Switches to the Project Details tab.
effects.affects: Only the displayed project-details section changes.
effects.check: Click Project Details and verify that project detail information is displayed.

effects.does: Displays the selected Technical Stage response section.
effects.affects: Only the active stage and its response content shown on screen change.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that its response content is displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: Switches to the RFQ stage tab.
effects.affects: Only the active stage and its displayed content change.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that the RFQ stage content is displayed.

effects.does: Switches to the Master QCS tab.
effects.affects: Only the displayed project stage content changes.
effects.check: Click Master QCS and verify that the Master QCS content is displayed.

effects.does: Displays the responses for the selected stage.
effects.affects: Only the active response subsection changes.
effects.check: Click Responses and verify that vendor response content is displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: Switches to the stage overview subsection.
effects.affects: Only the displayed stage information changes.
effects.check: Click Overview and verify that the stage overview is displayed.

effects.does: Displays the project participants.
effects.affects: Only the participant list view changes.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the participant list and its response statuses are displayed.

effects.does: Displays remarks provided by participants.
effects.affects: Only the participant remarks view changes.
effects.check: Click Participant Remarks and verify that participant remarks are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the Shared With view or drawer.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Select Shared With and verify that the users or teams sharing the project are shown.

effects.does: Opens the form for extending the submission time.
effects.affects: If confirmed, it changes the event submission deadline.
effects.check: Select Extend Submission Time and verify that a deadline-extension dialog opens.

effects.does: Opens the withdrawal confirmation form.
effects.affects: If confirmed with a remark or attachment, it changes the project status to withdrawn.
effects.check: Select Withdraw and verify that the withdrawal dialog appears and cannot be confirmed with neither a remark nor an attachment.

effects.does: Opens the project's order activity.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Select Order Activity and verify that order-related activity for the project is displayed.

effects.does: Opens the form for editing the evaluation time.
effects.affects: If saved, it changes the event's evaluation schedule.
effects.check: Select Edit Evaluation Time and verify that the evaluation-time editor opens.

effects.does: Remains disabled and cannot be selected.
effects.affects: Nothing because no re-evaluation request can be initiated from this control.
effects.check: Verify that Request for Re-evaluation is visibly disabled and does not open a dialog when clicked.

effects.does: Navigates back to the project page.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Project and verify that the project page opens.

cases.title: Open the response template from the no-bids message
cases.setup: Open the project with the message "No bids placed yet.Click hereto view response template."
gaps: Assert that the response template opened: no confirmed template destination, identifying element, or dedicated assertion is provided.

cases.title: Open the withdrawal confirmation without completing withdrawal
steps: Inspect the withdrawal dialog without entering a remark or adding an attachment.
cases.expected: The withdrawal dialog opens. "Withdrawal Remarks" is marked with *. The confirmation action is disabled while the remark is blank and no attachment is added.
cases.setup: Use a project that can be withdrawn.
gaps: The required asterisk on Withdrawal Remarks cannot be reliably asserted without a confirmed label or representation for that marker.
The blank-form confirmation action cannot be reliably checked as disabled because its visible control name is not supplied or confirmed.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Responses screen.
Request withdrawal confirmation without completing withdrawal.
Assert the dialog displays the remark field named by the case.
Record the untouched dialog for inspection of the required marker and confirmation state; this capture does not assert either.

cases.title: Keep Request for Re-evaluation disabled when the screen has no eligible response
cases.expected: "Request for Re-evaluation" is disabled and cannot be selected.
cases.setup: Open the displayed project with no bids placed.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with no bids.
Assert the action is present but disabled and cannot be selected.

cases.title: Start Clara data analysis and follow its redirect
cases.expected: The message "Awarding initiated successfully, redirecting to awarding flow..." appears, then the browser navigates to the returned redirect_url.
cases.setup: Use a project where the Clara todo action is analyze_data and the service returns a redirect_url.
gaps: Ensure the prepared live project's Clara todo action is analyze_data and the service returns a redirect_url.
Read the service's returned redirect_url and assert that the browser navigates to that exact URL.
